“If they sin against you (for there is no man who doesn’t sin), and you are angry with them, and deliver them to the…
They have all gone aside. They have together become corrupt. There is no one who does good, no, not one.
Behold, I was born in iniquity. My mother conceived me in sin.
Who can say, “I have made my heart pure. I am clean and without sin?”
Surely there is not a righteous man on earth who does good and doesn’t sin.
Behold, I have only found this: that God made man upright; but they search for many schemes.”

translations.web: What is man, that he should be clean? What is he who is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?
translations.bsb: What is man, that he should be pure, or one born of woman, that he should be righteous?
translations.kjv: What is man, that he should be clean? and he which is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?
translations.asv: What is man, that he should be clean? And he that is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?
